2925.title: ACP model configuration error fallback
2925.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP bridge discards a failed advertised model configuration request and sends session/set_model without evidence that the agent supports it.

prReviews.topFinding: The static two-file diff removes the error fallback and uses the request that the session data supports. The investigation did not run the untrusted branch.

2925.proposedFix: Use the advertised model configuration option and preserve its error. Use session/set_model only for the separate session-model state path.
2925.caveats: The reproduction used the repository fake ACP agent. It did not use a third-party provider or account.
